_comment: Proposed additions to schemas/node.schema.json (metadax.node/0.3) to fix B09 and B10. These keys are added under properties (additionalProperties is false, so they must be declared). None are required, so existing nodes stay valid.

status._why: B10 — the registry can represent 'abandoned' without replaying session logs.

abandoned_count._why: B10 — count of sessions that abandoned a path rooted at this node.

lost_count._why: B10 — count of sessions that reported being lost here.

markers._why: B09 — markers attach to the node by its opaque id, not a side-file keyed by (module,concept,depth).
